description.value: Established in 2003 by Ping Chou, Adonia Tea House is a sit-down British-style afternoon tea room in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood, decorated with antique furniture, fine bone china, and classic architectural features. Named after the Greek god of beauty, it offers a curated selection of premium loose-leaf teas sourced from estates worldwide, served as part of a structured afternoon tea ceremony with housemade finger sandwiches, pastries, and scones. Takeout is available for those who prefer to eat on the move, and an online shop lets cyclists pick up loose-leaf teas to take on the road.
